**Experimental mod only for testing!**

Main feature of this mod is ability to use **box32**. 
If **WoW64** mode is enabled, WoW64 Wine is used (default).
If **WoW64** mode is disabled, the regular bi-arch Wine is used with the **box32** feature. For now, some x86 OpenGL games work in **box32** mode with higher performance than in WoW64 mode.

- Built-in custom **frame generation** (_Screen effects -> Frame generation_).
- Support of **Russian** input (Unicode) from the on-screen keyboard.
- **Freedreno** OpenGL driver, **LLVMPipe** driver.
- Optional **Lorie X-server**.
- **Old VirGL** test server with better compatibility.

It is recommended to _disable WoW64_ mode with **VirGL** for better performance.

**Changes:**
- Added **vkBasalt** sharpness effects for shortcuts (from Winlator Bionic).
- Upgraded **Frame generation**: improved _motion estimation_, added _FPS multiplier_ (x2, x3, x4), added _Motion scale_, _Blending_ and _Post-processing_ adjustments, added _Engine_ options (DIS, QCOM, GLES).

releases.name: ares v148
releases.body:
ares v148 has now been released.

This release includes big improvements to a number of ares cores. Highlights include rewrites to the N64 CPU & RSP JITs resulting in significant performance gains across the N64 library, additional implementation & accuracy improvements to the PlayStation core, fixes to the GBA core, and support for the Famicom data recorder & Dendy. 

Additionally, there have been many updates to the core ares application across all platforms. Per-core input configuration has been added, updated video, audio, & input drivers are available, bug fixes, additional options have been added, and core dependencies have been updated. 

Since v147, 20 contributors have created 300 commits to the ares codebase.

As always, if you wish to see the full changelog in a per-commit format along with their authors, you can do so on GitHub [here](https://github.com/ares-emulator/ares/compare/v147...v148).

ares v145 has now been released.

This release contains hefty improvements to a number of ares components. Highlights include Real Time Clock support for the Game Boy Advance, improvements to the experimental PlayStation core, Sega SC-3000 support, important fixes to the Game Boy Color, as well as core improvements to the ares application itself that should improve performance and responsiveness.

Since v144, 8 contributors have created 90 commits to the ares codebase.

As always, if you wish to see the full changelog in a per-commit format along with their authors, you can do so on GitHub [here](https://github.com/ares-emulator/ares/compare/v144...v145).

**ARM7TDMI (Game Boy Advance CPU, ST018 Super Famicom coprocessor)**

- Implemented many undocumented instruction encodings
- Implemented invalid CPSR modes
- Added support for MRC, MCR, and CDP coprocessor instructions
- Allowed misalignment of the program counter in ARM mode

**Nintendo - Game Boy Color**

- Improved HDMA and GDMA timings (fixes some major graphical bugs)

**Nintendo - Game Boy Advance**

- Added support for the Real Time Clock
- Re-introduced optional Game Boy Player support

## NieR:Automata Android Recomp v0.2.7

### Español
- **Soporte multi-región y fix de modelos negros (PR #26 / PR #27):** Resolución automática `ADRP+LDR` para USA y Asia 1.0.3 (presenter y resolución dinámica mínima `0.6`) y firma ampliada de 8 instrucciones en `mesh_draw_hook` para evitar falsos matches y modelos/naves en negro.
- **Corrección de reflejos/cubemaps negros:** Añadido `VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT` en texturas `2D_ARRAY` cuadradas de `6n` capas.
- **Optimizaciones de rendimiento NVN:** Salida rápida con `memcmp` + comparación SIMD NEON ARM64 en write-backs (`apply_write_back`), pool de snapshots (`g_before_pool`) y pool de buffers spill (`g_staging_pool`) para reducir pausas de CPU y asignaciones de memoria por frame.
- **Fix Android 10 (API 29) y diagonales en mando:** Guard de `InsetsController` para evitar crashes al iniciar en Android 10 y zona muerta radial 2D para sticks físicos.

---

### English
- **Multi-region hooks & black models fix (PR #26 / PR #27):** Automatic `ADRP+LDR` slot resolution across USA and Asia 1.0.3 builds (presenter & dynamic-res floor `0.6`) plus expanded 8-instruction `mesh_draw_hook` signature to prevent black 3D models/ships.

- 整合声音、对白、亮度、纹理、植被显示与运行时内存修复，混音器默认启用。
- 修正 Mali 顶点整数属性与着色器输入类型匹配，RG477M 人物已可正常显示。

RG477M / MT6897 / Mali-G615 / Android 14 已验证安装、原版 Ver1.07 标题、声音恢复、人物显示、开场至户外与城镇流程、虚拟手柄和原游戏存档缩略图。图形组件测试 64 项中 63 通过、1 项缺私有输入跳过，运行时 8 项通过。

releases.body:
* Fixed GB, GBC and GBA games running slow on PAL (576i) 50Hz output
* Fixed JIT IRQ latency bug causing graphical artifacts
* **Restored the original controls of the games with special Wii controls** (Zelda, Mario, Metroid, Ninja Turtles, Mortal Kombat, Star Wars, Harry Potter, Medal of Honor, Boktai, The Lord of the Rings, Castlevania and the rest). releases.body:
Changes since the latest beta release:
- Fixed two UI issues (#843, #846)
- Fixed a bug in the CBM file system implementation (#853)
- Fixed a bug in the drive idle logic (#854)
- Fixed three drive-related VICE tests (#668, #674, #675)

Core and API

* Public API: The API now has as new shape. There are async counterparts (…Async) for state-changing calls, set is now setAsync, there is a new MemoryDebugger API, more getters, and suspend/resume coverage across the API.
* Threading: The command queue and message queue are now std::deque-based. Messages can carry exceptions. AudioPort is thread-safe. Cmd::CALL, TRACK_ON and TRACK_OFF are new.
* Messages: Msg::CONFIG is sent for every option change. ROM_LOADED, RSH_DONE and CONFIG_ERROR are new.
* RetroShell: It has the new architecture from vAmiga, with multiple shells and a single console per shell.
* Workspaces: A screenshot is now saved inside saveWorkspace().
* X-Ray: GPU X-Ray support is added, with a new XRAY_COMPOSITOR option.
* Shared libraries: utlib and rvlib were merged with the versions shared with vAmiga and Silicium.
* Cleanup: Header, include and namespace cleanups, plus removal of orphaned files.

Fixes

* Drive::isIdle() is fixed (#854).

This maintenance release primarily addresses issue #851, which prevented the app from running on the upcoming macOS 27 Golden Gate. It also includes internal code changes required to make the core compatible with the architecture of the upcoming Silicium emulator.
Removing beta status, as no significant bugs have been reported for some time.

## Refactoring

This beta release introduces substantial changes to the underlying code base. As part of the development of the RetroVault app, a new **RetroVault** library has been created. This library is now responsible for managing:

- File systems  
- Devices  
- All supported image formats  

RetroVault is designed as a standalone library and is also used in the latest version of vAmiga for the same purpose.

In addition, the new **utlib** library has been introduced. All utility functions previously embedded in vAmiga and VirtualC64 have been refactored into this more powerful shared library. This makes it easier for me to share common functionality among the different emulators. 

## Enhancements

- The disassembler now supports symbol files (#837)

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a crash in the file system importer when importing excessively large folders (#841)  
- Fixed a bug in the VIC inspector that prevented selecting individual sprites in Tahoe (#840)

releases.name: CosmoU 0.13.0
releases.body:
## ✨ A calmer, clearer CosmoU

CosmoU 0.13 reworks the whole interface. All the features are still there, just sorted better, so every window and every theme feels like one product: easy to understand on the first start, calm with a big library, readable from the sofa.

## What changed

- **Play is always the strongest button** – in Covers, Grid, the Wii U Look and the game details. Details and the other actions are quieter.
- **Grid** – a calm banner: the cover sharp in front of its own softly blurred colours, instead of a giant pixelated picture.
- **Game details** – a smaller cover, Play first, *Add to favorites* as a quiet toggle, one line instead of four empty statistics before the first play, the tools in one row, save data and updates as simple rows.
- **Settings** – a calmer category bar (only the open category is in colour), a bigger search with its shortcut (Ctrl F / ⌘F).
- **Quick Menu** – your games first, then three clear groups: **Look**, **Sound** and **System**.
- **Theme gallery** – big cards with a preview picture of every theme.
- **Empty screens lead somewhere** – *Clear search*, *Show the library*, or the folder button of the console you're looking at.

releases.name: Xenoblade 3 port v0.4.0
releases.body:
## No more blinking objects after loading

While the game is running, each new combination of shader and render state needs a GPU pipeline. Pipelines the app has never seen are built in the background so the game doesn't freeze, and until one is ready the objects that use it are not drawn. Until now that also happened to pipelines it had already built in an earlier session. Only the first 4,000 were prepared at start-up, in the order they first appeared, so later in the game whole areas came from the background again. The result was objects and textures blinking for a few frames after loading a save or when walking into an area.

- Pipelines that the app has already built on your device are now created on the spot, in about a quarter of a millisecond each and within a small per-frame budget, so they are drawn from the first frame.
- Start-up preparation now begins with the pipelines your last session used (`pipelines_recientes.bin` in the game folder), not with the ones from the beginning of the game.
- Areas you visit for the very first time can still show an object a moment late while its pipeline is built. The second visit is clean.

Ahora el juego va en modo inmersivo: las dos barras se ocultan y deslizando desde un borde salen un momento. Comprobado en la Flip 2.

# reNut Android 0.4.0

An experimental Android port of **Banjo-Kazooie: Nuts & Bolts** (Xbox 360), built from a static recompilation of the game.

> **Heads up:** this is a vibe-coded port. Expect bugs, rough edges and uneven compatibility across devices.

## Features

- **Local multiplayer** for two players: connect a second gamepad and it joins as player 2.
- **No GPU command-stream emulation.** The game's Direct3D calls are translated straight into Vulkan through Plume, the same renderer layer UnleashedRecomp uses, with shaders recompiled ahead of time. Some Xbox 360 GPU behaviour (resolves, texture formats, tessellation, memexport) is still emulated on the host.
- **In-app achievements** section.
- **Graphics options** to trade quality for performance:
  - internal resolution
  - texture resolution
  - shadow resolution
- **Adrenotools driver support**, a bundled Turnip driver and Turnip tuning options.
- **Save import and export.**

## Performance

On a Galaxy S23 Ultra the game runs above 30 FPS at the original graphics settings. Other devices have not been tested, so your results will vary. If it runs slowly, lower the internal, texture and shadow resolution.

releases.name: v1.2.6: save backups, movies keep their shape, every controller works
releases.body:
**Save backups, movies that keep their shape, and two controllers at once.**

- **Save backups** (*CTRL → Game → Save backups …*): copies of all your save slots in a folder you choose, outside the app, so uninstalling the game doesn't delete them. A copy is made after the game saves, at most every 10 minutes. The latest 10 and one for each of the last 7 days played are kept, up to 64 MB in all (the latest 3 always). A backup can be restored from the same screen; it takes effect at the next start, and the saves it replaces are kept aside.
- **Movies are never stretched.** They keep their 16:9 shape with **Wide screen** on, and now also with **Stretch to fill wide screens** on. A movie whose own picture has black bars at the top and bottom as well (bars on all four sides) is zoomed in, centred, until one pair of bars is gone, without cutting anything off.
- **Controllers:** every connected controller now controls the game. Before, with two connected (for example a handheld's built-in controls and an external pad), the second one's buttons were ignored.

releases.name: v1.2.5: render resolution and true wide screens
releases.body:
**Choose the render resolution, and true wide screens.**

- **Resolution** (*CTRL → Image*, applies at the next start): **540p**, **720p** (as on the Xbox 360, the default) or **1080p**. The 3D world is drawn at that size; menus and the HUD stay sharp at 720p. 540p is faster and a little softer. 1080p is scaled down into the 720p picture, which smooths edges rather than adding detail, and needs a fast GPU.
- **Wide screen** (*CTRL → Image*, applies at the next start): on screens wider than 16:9 (most phones), the 3D world fills the whole screen, with more to see at the sides instead of black bars or stretching. Menus, the HUD and the minimap stay in the middle, laid out as on a 16:9 screen, and movies keep 16:9 with black bars. It costs some speed: on a Galaxy S10 (Adreno 640) the field runs at about 24.5 fps instead of 28. Off by default.
- With both left at their defaults, the picture is the same as in v1.2.4.

releases.name: v1.2.4: tidier CTRL menu with Exit game, fixes for more phones
releases.body:
**A tidier CTRL menu with Exit game, and fixes for more phones from the Dark Souls II port.**

- **CTRL menu:** the options are now in sections that open one at a time: *Controls*, *Frame rate and performance*, *Image*, *Second screen*, *Game* and *Troubleshooting*. **Exit game** (top right) closes the game after asking; save in the game's main menu first. After changing an option marked *, the menu offers to restart the game so it takes effect.
- **CTRL button:** under *Controls* it can stay on screen, slide into a small tab when not in use, or go away 30 seconds after the game starts. Once it's gone, Android's Back button or gesture opens the menu.
- **Frame rate:** one list with 30, 40, 60 and *60 fps, smoother* (the former 120 Hz option).
- **Mali GPUs (Dimensity, Exynos, Tensor):** the app now starts on Arm's own driver, with the renderer settings that fixed Mali players' glitches in the Dark Souls II port, which shares this renderer. Still untested on a real Mali phone: reports with logs are welcome.
- **Adreno 8xx (Snapdragon 8 Elite):** Turnip now runs in sysmem mode there, which fixed GPU hangs on these chips in the Dark Souls II port.

releases.name: v1.2.3: fix for Adreno 600-series GPUs
releases.body:
**Fix for Adreno 600-series GPUs (Snapdragon 855 / 865 / 870 / 888 and similar).**

- **Adreno 6xx:** the renderer no longer loses work on these GPUs. Missing menu text, garbled or black pictures and wrong colours came from the Turnip driver on Adreno 6xx dropping some of the renderer's compute work (texture loads and render-to-texture copies) when it was set up while a drawing pass was still open. The fix closes the pass first. It was found by the Dark Souls II port's frame capture on an Adreno 640 and tested here on a Galaxy S10 (Adreno 640) (#4). Adreno 7xx/8xx draw the same as before, at the same speed.

**Updating from v1.2.2:** install `lr-recomp-android-arm64.apk` (below) over it. Your saves, game files, shaders and settings are kept.

Fixes the ConsolePort wizard reappearing on every login ([reported on Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/EmulationOnAndroid/)).

# typex2-recomp 0.7.4

Building games on Windows with LLVM already installed, and a log of slow frames.

What's new:

- **Windows: no more "unsupported option '-fPIC'".** If LLVM's own clang was installed on your
  PC and the launcher's clang wasn't downloaded, building a game failed with that error
  ([#8](https://github.com/PabloVSouza/typex2-recomp/issues/8)). That clang can't build games
  for the player; the launcher now says so and points you to Settings → Tools, where
  *LLVM clang* downloads the one it needs.
- **Slow frames in the log (Vulkan).** Adding `X2_PACELOG=30` under a game's Environment
  logs every frame that takes over 30 ms (at most one line a second), with how long it waited
  for the GPU and where the rest went. If a game slows down for you, a log made this way
  helps find out why.

## Known issues

See [Known issues](https://github.com/PabloVSouza/typex2-recomp/blob/main/docs/Known-Issues.md).

## Install or update

1. **Update the launcher on your computer:** download it below (`.dmg` for macOS on Apple
   Silicon, `.AppImage` or `.deb` for Linux, `.msi` or setup `.exe` for Windows) and install it
   over the old one. Your library and settings stay.

Frostpunk for Android 0.4-dev improves touch camera controls, mobile interface readability, and native Vulkan stability. This release includes all previously unpublished 0.3.3-dev changes; it updates 0.3.2.1-dev directly.

## Changes

- Fix pinch-to-pan camera transitions and two-finger gestures after construction. Blizzard ambience now changes smoothly with zoom.
- Enlarge scout diary text and improve fonts and layouts across the world map, technology tree, laws, building information, and other mobile panels.
- Fix the FPS overlay appearing behind the game surface and false crash reports after closing the game from Recent apps.
- Add entity-table bounds checks to prevent crashes while clearing construction previews.
- Package native Vulkan with system, Turnip, and PanVK driver options. Remove DXVK and FSR 3 from the APK, migrate saved renderer choices, and improve renderer failure handling.
- Add Qualcomm shader interface workarounds and save Vulkan pipeline caches in the background for reuse on subsequent launches.
- Improve launcher compatibility checks, texture preparation, messages, and translations. Add an ADPF toggle, enabled by default on supported devices.

releases.body:
Frostpunk for Android 0.3.2-dev makes native Vulkan the default, adds an in-game performance overlay, and improves touch controls and memory use.

## Gameplay and performance

- Pinch to zoom and rotate the camera in the same gesture. The construction cursor can now reach the edges of the map.
- Enable a configurable overlay for FPS, frame times, CPU and GPU information, memory usage, temperatures, and more.
- Reduce CPU work in busy cities with native ARM64 routines for scene visibility and object processing. Both renderers also reduce the memory used by some oversized interface textures.

## Rendering and compatibility

- Native Vulkan now has separate system, Turnip, and PanVK modes. The launcher checks the selected driver and explains why a mode is unavailable. DXVK remains available as a fallback.
- Improve frame synchronization, Vulkan device-loss diagnostics, and driver handling on supported Mali and PowerVR devices. Bundled PanVK requires 4 KiB kernel pages.
- The launcher checks whether the selected driver can read the original textures. If ASTC conversion is needed, it can prepare the cache and continue launching afterward. The original game files are preserved.

releases.name: Frostpunk for Android 0.3.1-dev
releases.body:
Frostpunk for Android 0.3.1-dev fixes crashes triggered by some achievements and events, improves native Vulkan and PanVK compatibility, and expands launcher localization and crash reporting.

## Gameplay and stability

- Fix a crash triggered by achievement and event names containing a colon, including `Endless: Backup Plan`. The offline Steam bridge now handles those names and returns errors for individual rejected storage operations.
- Fix parsing of numbered save names such as `Name-3`. Add Win64 runtime support for wide-string integer parsing, numeric conversions and C++ exception-message handling.
- Handle requests for the offline Steam store overlay and external menu links without launching a browser.

## Rendering and touch controls

- Extend experimental Native Vulkan (PanVK) and DXVK (PanVK) checks to Mali and Immortalis devices on Android 11 or newer. Bundled PanVK requires 4 KiB kernel pages. Devices with other page sizes can import a compatible driver and run the launcher check.
- Restore missing ground snow when starting a new game in native Vulkan by correcting how the renderer caches texture bindings.

releases.name: Frostpunk for Android 0.3-dev
releases.body:
Frostpunk for Android 0.3-dev adds experimental native Vulkan rendering, touch construction improvements, and a smaller APK.

## Security: Steam token redaction in logs

GameHub Lite 5.1.8 fixes a logging issue where Steam authentication-related values could appear in diagnostic logs. 
In some cases, logs could include fields such as `steamToken`, `refreshToken`, or `accessToken` from Steam login/launch flows.

**Publicly posted logs containing these fields should be deleted or redacted.**

This should go without saying but If you find any security issues, please reach out **PRIVATELY**. 
I have not checked if this issue is still present in recent GameHub versions, already ruined my one day off I was spending with my family by the person who reported this publicly and I do not plan on spending any more time on this.

releases.body:
## v11.5 摘要

**批量 / 扫描导入** — 导入向导第一步新增「批量扫描导入（多选）」：选一个目录（例如 Download），用 SAF 扫出候选——顶层带 `.exe` / `.rpy` / `.rpyc` / `.xp3` / `.rpa` / `.ypf` / `.wolf` / `.rgssad` / `.nsa` 之一，或是 Ren'Py 的 `game/` 目录；套娃目录只下探一层，跳过隐藏目录与运行时目录。勾选后**串行**导入，每条独立汇报「等待 / 复制中 / 导入中 / 已导入 / 失败」，失败项复用单条导入的回滚（删已建容器根目录 + 清暂存）。批量**不**自动拉起内置引擎，导完统一回游戏库自己点。

**分类过滤由「单选」升级为「三维组合」** — 引擎 + 品类 + 标签可同时生效（AND），同一维度再点一次取消；筛空时空态文案改为「没有匹配的游戏」。「继续游玩」改为按最后启动时间倒序且只收真启动过的（`lastPlayedAt > 0`）——此前是「列表前 3 个」，名不副实；没玩过任何游戏时整段隐藏。

**封面（提取修复 + 用户自定义）** — ①`BitmapFactory` 解不了 PE 资源里的原始 DIB，所以卡片封面一直是占位图；新增 `IconCodec` 兜底（补 14 字节 `BITMAPFILEHEADER`、`biHeight` 减半剥掉 AND 掩码层、按 8bpp 调色板算偏移），组内候选按字节数降序逐个重试——真机上那款 Unity 游戏的 exe 图标首次正常显示。②详情页「维护 → 封面」可**从相册选图**或**恢复自动**，优先级 自定义 > 目录图 > exe 图标；选图先落 `.tmp` 并实际解码一次，解不开的不落盘。③修「换完封面回列表仍显示占位图」：解码完成前同一位置可能已被重绑到另一个 View，旧逻辑只贴给回调持有者；现在解码完成后让列表按缓存位图重画一次。

**UI 修正（真机实测出来的）** — 多选条加「品类 / 标签」后，六个动作把「已选 N 项」挤成 0 宽、「完成」被截断：标签简化为「删除 / 移除」、收紧边距、计数给最小宽度，全部回到一行内。「彻底删除 / 仅移除」确认弹窗从**只报数量**改为**列出游戏名**，并写明原生游戏的收纳副本同样会被删（真机复验时因只报数量误删过一批，当场从仍在的源目录重新导入恢复）。

releases.name: v11.4
releases.body:
## v11.4 摘要

**导入重做** — 第一步从「手输路径」换成系统文件夹选择器（`ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE` + persistable 授权），授权跟目录走、不随卸载重装重置；所选目录先复制进应用私有暂存（带进度、失败清半成品、可用空间 <128MB 硬失败、6h 残骸清扫）再走原管线。

**导入假成功链（真机事故 D1–D5）** — 重装后「所有文件访问」被系统重置时 `listFiles()` 为 null，旧行为一路「成功」到启动才报「启动文件缺失」：现 step0 fail-fast 并带用户去授权页。同批修复：解压套娃目录归一（`resolveGameRoot`，JVM 回归 E15–E21）、库条目回填标题/引擎、CJK 目录名塌缩改附哈希后缀、容器名恒等 `galgame-<gameId>`（避让上移到 id 派生）、导入失败回滚已建容器、复制完成无 exe 当场告警、重复导入先确认。

**游戏库分类** — 顶部 chips 单选过滤：引擎自动归类（多于一种才出现）、预置内容品类（视觉小说 / 文字冒险 / 其他）、自定义标签；长按多选后「品类 / 标签」可一次给多张卡归类，标签可内联新建。

**数据安全三件** — ①「彻底删除」补删 `files/galgame-native` 收纳副本（此前数 GB 静默泄漏）并校验结果；②索引改 `.tmp`+`fsync`+rename 原子写，解析失败先隔离 `.corrupt-<ts>` 再重建；③存档管理器拒绝空 gameId（跨游戏串档），便携存档「先搬后链」改为合并不完整就不删源、链接失败把档拷回、同名冲突留 `.bak`。

**运维事实（重要）** — 卸载重装 / 清数据会重置全部文件权限（含「所有文件访问」），ColorOS/Android 16 上 shell 无法代授，只能用户手动开；新的导入流程不依赖该权限。

**真机验收** — RMX5010 / Adreno 830 / Android 16，release 包 11.4：选择器全链路（Download → 游戏目录 → 使用此文件夹）→ 检测 UNITY / 5 个文件 → 导入 → 单卡启动 → 标题菜单 → 正片连续推进对白 100s+；分类三条链路（品类/标签/引擎 chips，筛选取值 1/1/2）；把索引写成非法 JSON 后改一次分类 → 旧文件留档、新索引字段正确；注入 2MB 收纳副本后彻底删除 → 目录归空。

## v11.3 摘要

**界面** — Swiss 单首页 IA 与全站视觉重构：内页与游戏内 UI 收进同一套视觉语言；明暗双档走同一套主题 token（`values-night` 反相，状态栏图标随档位切换）；「设置 → 输入控制」从死路接成真入口；运行环境可管理（详情 / 重新注入语言字体 / 删除）。

**引擎** — 指纹扩展到 **19 个**（Siglus / YU-RIS / Artemis / CatSystem2 / AdvHD / SystemNNN / BGI / CMVS / Unity 等）；新增 `detectDeep()` 有限深度下钻（深度 ≤3、预算 4000 项），修子目录 `.xp3` 被判 UNKNOWN 后无法升级路由的问题。

**稳定性** — 修复 X server 输出流的静默截断与 SIGPIPE：`XOutputStream_send` 由裸阻塞 `write()` 改为 `send(MSG_NOSIGNAL)` 循环写满，EINTR 重试、EAGAIN 时 `poll` 上限 2 秒。

**工程** — box64 自建变成可复现资产（私有补丁导出 + 双向校验 + 构建脚本 + 打包器入库，版本不再写死）；类型门禁修绿（热点清单 3 → 6 条、`R` 桩 100 → 183 符号）；运行时资源 SHA-256 清单补齐 `assets` 子目录（34 → 57 个文件）。

# Oblivion for Android 0.1.3

APK: `Oblivion-0.1.3.apk` (arm64-v8a, Android 9+, Vulkan 1.1).
SHA-1 `e74c55c378825480eedb6b2c781946bc4bef3555`

## Fixed
- Mali GPUs: geometry no longer explodes into streaks on Mali GPUs (Exynos, Dimensity, Tensor, Kirin), which lack the clip-distance feature.

## Performance
- Each thread keeps its own cache of recently freed small blocks and reuses them without taking the global heap lock. In testing, an allocate-and-free went from about 34 ms to 5 ms. Freeing the same block twice is still detected and logged though.
- A thread that re-enters a lock it already holds now just counts up the way Windows does, instead of going through the real lock each time.
- Memory copies: the base memcpy routine, about 10% of all CPU, now runs as Android's native copy.
- The game reads the clock hundreds of thousands of times a second. QueryPerformanceCounter, GetTickCount and timeGetTime now read the processor's hardware timer instead of making a system call.
- A missing Data folder is now remembered after the first check - no repeated path search and log line each time.

Please attach `port/log.txt` from your Oblivion folder to any bug report.

Здесь собраны все изменения от **v1.2.1** до **v1.2.18** порта статической перекомпиляции Mass Effect (2007) для Android и Linux.

- **Режим экрана (растягивание на весь экран)**: добавлена настройка `port.stretch_mode` с тремя режимами:

# v1.2.1 — GEARMASS: нагрузка на все ядра; буфер команд («планировщик») из «me_1.2», доработанный

## GEARMASS — распределение нагрузки (`runtime/gearmass.c`)
Новая подсистема порта: решает, сколько потоков работает, как главные потоки ждут друг друга, на каких ядрах
они живут, сколько кадров CPU готовит вперёд и как поднимать качество, пока GPU свободен. **Никаких списков
телефонов и компьютеров**: всё выводится из топологии (число ядер, их частоты из `cpufreq`) и из замеров во время
игры.

Режимы (`ME1_GEARMASS`, лаунчеры → «Нагрузка (GEARMASS)» → «Режим нагрузки», `me1port.ini` `[Port] Gearmass`):

| | Эконом `eco` | Баланс `balance` | Производительность `perf` | Максимум `max` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Поток рендера `me1-d3d` (`ME1_D3D_CMD`) | 0 | 2 * | 2 * | 2 * |
| Рабочие потоки (`ME1_GM_WORKERS`) | 0 | до 2 | все свободные | все свободные |
| Кадров вперёд (`ME1_GM_AHEAD`) | 0 | 1 | 1 | 2 |
| Ожидание главных потоков (`ME1_GM_SPIN`) | сон | короткий спин | короткий спин | спин |
| Главные потоки на быстрых ядрах (`ME1_GM_PRIME`) | нет | нет | да | да |
| ADPF-цель / `uclamp.min` | — | — | 8 мс / 512 | 8 мс / 1024 |
| Лимит FPS | 30 | — | — | — |

## Что нового

- Порт игры на Linux (x86-64 и aarch64): X11 и Wayland, рендеры OpenGL ES, Vulkan и Zink. Клавиатура, мышь с захватом

  графика, моды, DLC, переменные окружения, журнал запуска. До первого кадра игры показывается экран загрузки.
- Разумные значения по умолчанию: Vulkan на дискретной видеокарте, разрешение рабочего стола, без ограничения FPS,
  точная эмуляция float D3D9 (без чёрных и белых точек).
- Установка через `linux/install.sh` (ярлык, иконка, удаление через `--uninstall`).

### Сборка
- Два скрипта в корне исходников — `build-linux.sh` и `build-android.sh` (справка по `-h`).
- Сами находят игру (Steam, в том числе Flatpak и Snap, `~/Games`, `~/GOG Games`, папки Wine) или берут её из `--game`.

releases.name: v1.0.0 — Winlator 适配包
releases.body:
在 Android（[Winlator](https://github.com/brunodev85/winlator)）与 ARM Linux（Wine + Box64）上运行 DFLegacy 60 版单机端的适配包。

## 包含

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `d3d8.dll` | d3d8to9 v1.15.1 预编译包装层（x86，124 KB） |
| `LICENSE.md` | d3d8to9 的 BSD-3-Clause 许可 |
| `使用说明.md` | 完整部署说明 |
| `放置说明.txt` | 快速上手 |

## 解决什么问题

客户端是 2008 年的 32 位程序，**只认 Direct3D 8**。Android 上的 DXVK 只支持 D3D9 及以上，直接跑会黑屏或崩溃。

这个 `d3d8.dll` 把 D3D8 调用逐条翻译成 D3D9：

```
DNF.exe → d3d8.dll → D3D9 → DXVK → Vulkan → Adreno / Mali
```

绕开 Wine 自带的 `wined3d → OpenGL` 路径，走 Vulkan 后端。

## 用法

1. 解压，把 `d3d8.dll` 复制到 `DNF.exe` 同级目录
2. Winlator 容器里设 `WINEDLLOVERRIDES=d3d8=n,b`
3. Box86 / Box64 都打开，DXVK 选 2.x
4. 运行 `DNF.exe`

**Windows 本机不要放这个文件** —— 原生 D3D8 路径工作正常，放进去反而改变渲染路径。

## 前提

服务端需要是 x86 构建（NativeAOT `-r win-x86`），否则在纯 32 位环境里加载不了。相关改动见 [DFLegacyAot](https://github.com/Yoshino-Loli/DFLegacyAot)。

## 未验证项

- `ijl15.dll` 的 WIC JPEG 解码在 Wine 下的表现
- Job Object 的退出联动在 Wine 下的可靠性（失败时手动结束服务端即可）

真机帧数需自行测试，骁龙 8 系预期 25~40 fps。

## 不包含

游戏客户端本体与任何受版权保护的资源。`DNF.exe`、`Script.pvf`、`ImagePacks2` 等权利归原权利人所有。

This launcher update fixes the GTA VI setup screen drawing in the upper-left quarter of the window.

releases.name: ZeraPS5 v0.1.1-b1215 — Menu text and Intel CPU compatibility
releases.body:
## ZeraPS5 v0.1.1-b1215

This Windows x64 release builds on b1214 and includes two graphics fixes and one CPU compatibility fix.

- Refresh tightly packed, single-channel texture atlases after small updates so letters remain visible in menus.
- Preserve the alpha channel when writing to the single-channel masks used by the GTA VI warning, Privacy Policy and Terms of Service panels.
- Emulate the PS5 CLZERO instruction when the host CPU raises an illegal-instruction exception. The instruction sequence reported on Intel passed an isolated test. An end-to-end retest on the affected Intel laptop is pending.

### Validation

- 196 automated checks passed on Windows, including 35 Vulkan checks on the RTX 5060 Ti.
- The b1214 installer applied the final ZIP in an isolated installation. Save, configuration, game and system-module test markers were preserved. Rollback and interrupted-installation recovery passed.
- The packaged executable displayed the Portuguese photosensitivity warning on the RTX 5060 Ti. An earlier development run of the same text fixes also displayed the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service and stopped with both boxes unchecked. Prologue gameplay remains unverified.

releases.name: ZeraPS5 v0.1.1-b1214 — Shader compiler update
releases.body:
## ZeraPS5 0.1.1 build 1214

This Windows x64 release updates the Vulkan shader compiler and includes the launcher and GPU writeback fixes shipped in b1192.

The translator simplifies a waterfall loop when it can prove that the emulated lane runs the body once. The new regression check covers both that case and a saved-mask register overlap where the loop must be retained.

Development testing of Grand Theft Auto VI reached the loading screen. The observation covers startup through loading. The translator change can trigger pipeline recreation on the first run.

### Validation

- 196 automated checks passed in the final serial runs, including 35 Vulkan checks on an RTX 5060 Ti.
- The b1192 updater installed the final ZIP in an isolated copy, preserved all five test data markers and passed rollback and interrupted-installation recovery.
- The Windows ZIP and the matching source archive were verified against the included checksums. Credits, component licenses and FFmpeg relink materials are included.

Use **Check for updates** in the launcher or download the Windows x64 ZIP below. Matching source and SHA-256 checksums are available on this page.

releases.body:
## ZeraPS5 v0.1.1 build 1191

The Windows x64 package includes matching sources, component licenses and relinkable objects. Some titles require the user’s own `libSceAgc.sprx`. The package excludes firmware modules and shaders extracted from them.

### Technical changes

- **Vulkan presentation.** Find GPU-written framebuffers through another mapping of the same memory. This fixed black output in the recorded development runs of The Messenger and Goodnight Universe.
- **Compute and writeback.** Start another batch when the writeback list fills. Finish queued reads while guest mappings remain pinned and compare GPU results with the same snapshot that was uploaded. Require 32-lane compute subgroups when the shader uses cross-lane operations.
- **System services.** Extend AMM and AMPR memory and file operations, add semaphore and Audio3D handling, and provide non-PSSR fallback responses from `libScePsml`.
- **Launcher.** Show the library counts when no system library is installed. Keep the missing-module message for games that require one. Supported Unreal profiles can also be read from PKG and exFAT applications.

### Game observations

releases.name: FableDroid 0.9.0
releases.body:
FableDroid 0.9.0: about 99% of the game's code is now decompiled to native code (59,958 of 60,481 functions: game code 99.5%, library code 98.5%). The remaining ~520 functions still run through the recompiled path and are being rewritten by hand.

### Status
- Tested on the AYN Thor (Adreno 740): boots, loads a save and plays the full forest route with no crashes.
- Performance on the Thor: the default is a locked 30 FPS (the Xbox 360's cap, steadiest). With the experimental 60 FPS setting (Settings > Frame rate) it runs about 57 FPS median, with lows around 37 FPS in heavy scenes; 40 and 60 FPS can stutter briefly while walking.
- Adreno 8xx (Odin 3, Snapdragon 8 Elite/Gen 5) and Mali are still untested on this build. Reports and logs are very welcome.

### Known issues
- The item wheel in the on-screen display occasionally draws incorrectly.

### Installing
Installs over 0.6.x as a normal update; your game files and saves are kept.

New installs: install the APK and follow the setup steps in the README. You still need your own copy of Fable II (Game of the Year edition); no game files are included.

## What's new
- **Fixed: purple strip along the bottom of the screen.** Fable II clears some buffers by drawing a rectangle over them. Clears now only replace the rows they actually draw. No performance cost: still a steady 30 FPS on the Thor.

**Bring your own game:** you need an ISO of a supported Fable II disc. This APK contains no game data (no art, audio, maps or video).

1. Download **FableDroid-0.6.0-beta.apk** below and open it on your device.

## Highlights
- Native arm64 + Vulkan, 30 FPS cap held on an AYN Thor (Snapdragon 8 Gen 2) at 720p
- Low-latency mode and high tick rate on by default
- FXAA + dithered foliage instead of slow MSAA
- Install straight from the ISO on the device, one-tap save backup
- Controller remapping, touch controls with a layout editor
- Bundled Mesa Turnip driver plus a driver manager
